title: Chunk-friendly structure: write pages a retriever can slice cleanly
metric: chunks that come out self-contained from a fixed-size splitter (chunk_size = 800, no overlap)
limitations: Measures a machine-legibility proxy (whether a chunk stands alone after fixed-size splitting), not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: Chunk-friendly structure: write pages a retriever can slice cleanly
metric: chunks the splitter produces from the document
limitations: Measures a machine-legibility proxy (whether a chunk stands alone after fixed-size splitting), not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: SSR vs CSR: make your content visible to AI crawlers
metric: words of the HTML source a crawler that does not execute JavaScript can read
tool: perl + bash (tag/script stripping over the HTML source)
limitations: Measures the mechanical visibility of the text to a fetch-only crawler, not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: Structured data (JSON-LD): make your facts machine-readable
metric: typed facts a JSON-LD/schema.org parser extracts (keys other than @context/@type on a typed object)
limitations: Measures the extractability of typed statements from the page source, not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: Structured data (JSON-LD): make your facts machine-readable
metric: typed entities a JSON-LD/schema.org parser extracts (objects carrying an @type)
limitations: Measures the extractability of typed statements from the page source, not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: AI crawler access: allow AI crawlers in robots.txt + publish an llms.txt
metric: AI crawler user-agents allowed by robots.txt for path / (of the 8 tested)
limitations: Measures a precondition (reachability and an extractable feed), not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: AI crawler access: allow AI crawlers in robots.txt + publish an llms.txt
metric: bytes of curated content exposed by llms.txt
limitations: Measures a precondition (reachability and an extractable feed), not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: Entity clarity: disambiguate with sameAs + canonical IDs
metric: named entities resolved to exactly one canonical Wikidata Q-ID via @id or sameAs
limitations: Measures the mechanical resolvability of each name to one canonical identifier, not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: Entity clarity: disambiguate with sameAs + canonical IDs
metric: named entities the page declares in its about list
limitations: Measures the mechanical resolvability of each name to one canonical identifier, not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: Citation anchoring: put a linkable source next to every claim
metric: claim-to-source pairs a deterministic parser extracts (a claim line carrying an inline http(s) link)
limitations: Measures how many claim-to-source pairs a parser can lift from the document, not whether any answer engine cites the page.

title: Citation anchoring: put a linkable source next to every claim
metric: claims inside the marked claims block
limitations: Measures how many claim-to-source pairs a parser can lift from the document, not whether any answer engine cites the page.
